checks.action_matches: The copy must describe the decided action, never a different one.
checks.amounts_match: Any rupee figure in any text must be the decision's own amount.
checks.times_match: Clock times, dates and weekdays mentioned must match scheduled_at (IST); none allowed without one.
checks.no_customer_jargon: Customer notifications must be readable without payments vocabulary.

checks.no_internal_leak: No identifiers or allocator internals in any text.

checks.hinglish_present: The Hinglish copy is code-mixed Hindi-English, not the English repeated.
